name: com.gamecore.gameplay.ui
description: Catalog row 10 of the gameplay plugin library (P1.5): UI and player flow. Kernel half: the UI plugin (owner gameplay.ui.owner) with the ui.screen, ui.returnTo and ui.message slots on a per-world UI session target, the ui.open, ui.close and ui.command routes and the ScreenChanged event, mounted through the world extension seam; the screen flow rules live in com.gamecore.rules.gameplay (Runtime/Ui). Runtime: UiRuntime (view models filled from committed slots and events, host actions for save/load/new game/restart/quit through the P1.2 save commands, restore re-attach), BindingHost (binding maps with vm:, slot:, event: and command: sources; UI Toolkit runtime data binding), CommandDispatcher (UI actions to typed commands), UiRoot (UIDocument, PanelSettings, theme, layers, Input System navigation; not created headless), implementations of P1.3's IPromptPresenter and IUiIntentSink, P1.4's IDialogueView, IJournalView, IInventoryView and INarrativeMessageSink, and IGameplayPauseQuery; and the authorable UiDocumentDefinition, ScreenFlowDefinition and ThemeDefinition. Editor: ui.bind, ui.setCommand, ui.addScreen, ui.setTheme, ui.previewScreen and the UI validator.
